issues.message: Join components not detected in MP file
issues.suggestion:
If graph contains joins, ensure:
  • Join keys are indexed/sorted
  • Smaller datasets joined first
  • Appropriate join type selected
  • Partition compatibility verified
  • Consider lookup alternatives for small reference data
Consider compression for large files to reduce I/O and storage costs
Good practice: Capture and analyze rejected records for data quality monitoring
Ensure adequate logging for troubleshooting: record counts, error messages, timing information
Good practice: Parameterization enables environment-independent deployment
Test in DEV, QA, and PROD environments to ensure portability
